data.long_meaning: Diyab means intelligent, clever, and wise. It is derived from the Arabic word 'diyaba' which means to be intelligent, knowledgeable, or to be wise in judgment. This name is a beautiful choice for parents who want to give their child a name that represents intelligence and wisdom. The name Diyab carries the meaning “Intelligent, Clever” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Diyab usually hope their child will grow to embody intelligent, clever and live with faith, good character and purpose.
